operators.name: custom_sum_dim1_keepdim
semantics: Sum input x along dimension 1 (channels), keepdim=True, producing shape (N, 1, H, W).
Input is contiguous float32 CUDA tensor with shape [16, 3, 4096, 4096].
Output is float32 CUDA tensor with shape [16, 1, 4096, 4096].

operators.name: custom_nan_to_num
semantics: Apply torch.nan_to_num with default nan=0.0, posinf=None, neginf=None, replacing NaN values with zero.
Input is contiguous float32 CUDA tensor with shape [16, 1, 4096, 4096].
Output is float32 CUDA tensor with same shape and values, NaNs replaced by 0.
Sum over dimension 1 (channels) from 3 to 1, keepdim=True.
Input shape [16, 3, 4096, 4096], output shape [16, 1, 4096, 4096], dtype float32 on CUDA.
Accumulation of three float32 channel values per spatial location.
Replace NaN values with 0.0, other values unchanged.
Output shape [16, 1, 4096, 4096], dtype float32 on CUDA.
Return final tensor with shape [16, 1, 4096, 4096], dtype float32 on CUDA.
